stem: A grower wants to top a plant that is already showing severe root-zone stress. Which decision is most defensible?
choices: Top immediately because high-stress training always improves vigor.
Delay the high-stress intervention until the underlying stress is understood and the plant is recovering.
Double irrigation volume and top at the same time.
Remove every growing tip so the plant uses less water.
rationale: High-stress training adds recovery demand. Stabilizing existing stress first reduces compounded injury and keeps the response interpretable.
